subject.title: Settings: single Model Providers page with auth state, quota, and cost per configured provider

question: Should this become a combined Models/Providers hub that also owns provider management, or a separate read-only Settings page alongside the existing Usage and provider-management surfaces?
rationale: Current RPC and UI evidence proves feasibility but cannot determine the intended navigation, ownership, and consolidation scope; the protected label confirms this is a maintainer product choice.

options.title: Combined Provider Hub
options.body: Use one Models/Providers area for status and management, built on shared summary components with links to detailed Usage analytics.

options.title: Separate Settings Overview
options.body: Implement the proposed read-only Settings page while retaining separate provider-management and Usage destinations.

options.title: Improve Existing Surfaces
options.body: Keep Overview and Usage as the destinations and improve their provider detail and cross-navigation without adding a new route.

recommendation.title: Combined Provider Hub
recommendation.body: Use one Models/Providers area for status and management, built on shared summary components with links to detailed Usage analytics.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest history across provider-usage infrastructure, authored this proposal, and is best positioned to decide the intended product boundary.
